DeleteWhenEmpty.Name: Delete empty chests
DeleteWhenEmpty.Hint: After the last coin and item are taken, close the chest and delete it from the Items sidebar. Scene markers are removed with it. Leave this off to keep the empty chest.

Sheet.Hint: Drag this chest from the Items tab onto a scene. Double-click the marker to open it.
Sheet.DropHint: Drag gear here from the Items sidebar or a compendium.
Sheet.DestinationHint: Take puts loot in carried inventory. If this character has a bag of holding or a shared container, Take asks where it should go. You can also drag an item onto their character sheet.
Sheet.DragHint: Drag an item onto a character sheet, or click Take.
Sheet.NoDestination: No character is available to receive loot.
Sheet.Combat: This chest cannot be looted during combat.
Sheet.Sealed: Unlock and disarm this chest before taking the loot.

Security.Title: Lock and trap
Security.RequestHint: Each button asks for that roll in chat. The character who clicks the card makes the check.
Security.RequestUnderstand: {chest}: a trap is here. Roll {skill} to learn how it works (DC {dc}).
Security.RequestUnderstandArc: {chest}: a trap is here. Roll {skill} to learn how the spell works (DC {dc}).
Security.RequestUnlock: {chest} is locked. Roll thieves' tools (DC {lockDc}) or Strength (DC {forceDc}).
Security.RequestSave: {name} sets off a trap on {chest}. Roll a {save} save (DC {dc}).
Security.StatusUnclear: A trap is here, but how it works is still unknown.
Security.Noticed: {name} notices a trap on {chest}, but not what kind.
Security.UnderstandFailed: {name} cannot tell how the trap on {chest} works.
Security.DisarmFailed: {name} fails to disarm {chest} ({total}). The trap fires.
Security.FailedSave: {name} fails the save against the trap (DC {dc}, rolled {total}).

Notifications.AlreadyTaken: That item is no longer in the chest.
Notifications.Combat: Chests cannot be looted during combat.
Notifications.NotGear: Only gear can be placed in a chest.
Notifications.NestedChest: A chest cannot be stored inside another chest.
Notifications.GmPlaceOnly: Only the GM can place a chest on a scene.
Notifications.NoDestination: Choose a character to receive the loot.
Notifications.MissingContainer: That container is no longer on the character.
Notifications.MissingChest: This chest is no longer in the world.
Notifications.TransferFailed: Could not move {name} into the inventory.
Notifications.Deleted: {name} was empty and has been deleted.
Notifications.DisarmFirst: Disarm the trap before unlocking the chest.
Notifications.RollFailed: The check could not be rolled.
Notifications.Asked: The roll request is in the chat.
Notifications.SelectCharacter: Select your character's token, or assign a character in the player configuration.
Notifications.NoGamemaster: A GM needs to be online to record the result.
